visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a 2D animation style. A green anthropomorphic frog wearing a blue suit is shown in a tight close-up, looking deeply distressed with large tears welling in its eyes. Large stylized text overlays the scene. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a tall, white heron-like bird wearing a gray suit, orange trousers, and glasses, sitting in an armchair within a cozy, dimly lit indoor room. The background features a wooden desk with a skull model, books, and a vase of yellow flowers. (3) The bird and the frog are shown in alternating close-ups as they engage in a conversation. The bird maintains a calm, professional posture while the frog appears increasingly vulnerable, with sweat beads appearing on its brow and more tears flowing. (4) A graphic of an 'Emotion Thermometer' appears on screen with a scale from 1 to 10; a blue brush-stroke mark is made near the bottom of the scale between 1 and 2. (5) The bird is seen gesturing calmly with its wing-hands toward the desk. The lighting remains soft and warm throughout the scene. (6) The video ends with the frog breaking down into heavy sobbing, covering its mouth with its hands as tears stream down its face.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這次讓人最安心的一句話. [Logo]: 维维编. (2) [Subtitle]: 「蛤蟆, 今天你感覺怎麼樣?」. (3) [Subtitle]: 「挺好的, 謝謝」. (4) [Subtitle]: 「我再問你一次, 你現在真實的感覺是怎麼樣的?」. (5) [Slogan]: 從小到大, 很多人被教導要「報喜不報憂」. (6) [Slogan]: 在心理諮詢裡, 第一步往往是幫當事人察覺這個自動化的「假回答」. (7) [Variety]: 情緒溫度計. (8) [Subtitle]: 「你有過自殺念頭嗎?」. (9) [Subtitle]: 「是的, 我有過」. (10) [Slogan]: 一般人並不建議以這樣的方式詢問, 直接詢問不會增加自殺風險, 反而能減少孤立感. (11) [Subtitle]: 「故事很長」. (12) [Subtitle]: 「我耐心聆聽」. (13) [Slogan]: 這句話傳遞的是「你的故事值得被聽, 不會被打斷或評判」.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An animated green frog in a blue suit and a tall white heron in a gray suit and glasses.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A cozy, quiet consultation room with a wooden table, books, a human skull model, a box of tissues, a lamp, and a floral arrangement under soft window lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Soft, melancholic piano music fades in. A male narrator introduces the theme in a calm, professional tone. (2) A transition whoosh sound leads into a dialogue scene. A mature, resonant male voice (the bird) asks a question. A slightly higher-pitched, strained male voice (the frog) responds briefly with a hint of breathiness. (3) The narrator returns, explaining a psychological concept over the continuing piano bed. (4) The bird's voice returns with a serious, gentle query. The frog's voice becomes audibly more emotional, exhibiting significant vocal tension and a slower speech rate as he admits to difficult thoughts. (5) The narrator concludes with a warm, steady delivery, emphasizing the healing power of listening, as the piano music swells slightly and then fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Dialogue Simulation -> Educational Explanation -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate and provide comfort regarding mental health and psychological support. It uses an animated metaphor of a therapy session between a frog and a bird to illustrate the importance of active listening and breaking through social facades of happiness to address true emotional pain.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes anthropomorphic characters and a warm color palette to make a heavy psychological subject more accessible and empathetic.
